resolution: Silenced the three per-frame dev-terminal probes that were flooding the console and burying the [edit-latency] readout the user wants to read. (1) The [hb] heartbeat (perfWatch startPerfHeartbeat — a req_1735 TEMP probe started unconditionally from index.tsx) now returns early unless globalThis.__perfHeartbeat is set — opt-in, off by default. (2) The [r3d-census] and [ground-pass] diagnostics in gpu/3d.zig (req_0727) printed every 120 frames unconditionally; both are now gated behind a cached RJIT_R3D_CENSUS env flag (mirrors the existing RJIT_PERFLOG/censusOn pattern). Default is quiet so the per-verb edit-latency lines read clean in the terminal. The heartbeat fix is cart-side and hot-reloads immediately (the worst spammer, gone now); the two census gates compile clean (ReleaseFast) and land on the next dev-host rebuild. Re-enable either probe deliberately when debugging (set the global / the env). req_1931 (an on-screen HUD) is moot — the user said console is fine, they just needed the spam gone.
